Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory284.jpg'}
{1: 'Babylonia Command HQ - Military Communications Center', 2: 'Day of the Moon Rock Strike'}
{2: 'Day of the Moon Rock Strike\\nBabylonia Command HQ - Military Communications Center'}
{3: 'The comms center in Babylonia never changes its light. Cool and constant, it paints every face with an identical veneer of detachment and discipline.'}
{3: 'Personnel move through their routines with smooth precision. Routine means control here.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiSHanshuoNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'Until one screen bursts into violent crimson.'}
{3: "The red glare slicks across skin like fresh blood. The young comms officer's eyes dart toward the superior, only to find the operations officer has already keyed the broadcast open."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'All stations, stand by for emergency mission briefing.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1597.jpg'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiSHanshuoNew.prefab'}

{3: "Across the Military Security Area, projections rise above the Construct squads' planning tables. A full schematic of the Atlantic Eye hangs suspended, gray exclusion zones radiating outward from the dam in concentric rings."}
{3: 'And crawling across those once-neutral waters, dark crimson veins pulse and breathe like the vascular system of some vast animal, like roots that writhe and feed, spreading everywhere at once.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'Atlantic Sargasso Sea. Punishing Virus concentration breached critical levels in under two minutes.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'Multiple intelligence sources confirm an anomaly at the Atlantic Eye. Red Tide output from the dam has tripled in the last twenty minutes. Cause unknown.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg1601_7.jpg'}

{3: 'Terminal screens flicker on in the shuddering cabins of transports, the hush of makeshift camps, and the edges of coastline conservation areas. On each one, the Red Tide stains the sea and spills into the gaze of waiting combat teams.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1597.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'All squads receiving this briefing, report to designated coordinates immediately for combat, support, or standby.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Wind tears across the staging ground, blending with the sharp percussion of steel on steel. It is the sound of war tuning its instruments.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'Be advised: the Comet Patrol Array has been uncontrolled since the Atlantic Calamity. This Red Tide breach puts it at extreme risk of corruption. The no-fly and no-sail zones surrounding the dam remain active.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1562.jpg'}

{3: "The Comet Patrol Array served as the Atlantic Eye's defensive mechanism. Its units link through energy pulses, weaving together into a wide-area protective shield. The dam's interior is sealed by the Ananke system, and together with the Comet Patrol Array, it forms a line of defense that has always kept out would-be intruders."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1597.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'Any aircraft or vehicle entering the zone risks interception by the Comet. This will not be easy.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{3: 'On the tactical map, across the ruins and along the winding coastline, tiny lights glow like scattered fireflies, pushing silently toward the giant wound that pours Red Tide into the sea.'}
{3: "The mission channel flips to encrypted. The operations officer's voice reaches every terminal at the forward edge of human resistance."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'Updated intelligence. The attacker has been provisionally identified as Arius Erhorn, accompanied by allied Ascendants. They have seized control of the lunar base and launched a moon rock strike against the Atlantic Eye, accelerating the spread of the Punishing Virus...', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'We suspect his current objective is the Atlantic Eye itself... Should it fall into enemy hands, the current control system becomes a weapon. The Punishing Virus will spread at a rate we cannot measure.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'Our elite force will intercept and pursue. All squads will advance on the Atlantic Eye in waves via separate routes. Check your terminals for mission route assignments.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{3: "Navigation packages surge from central command to each waiting squad's display. The message closes the way it always does, with phrases worn into every soldier's memory."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Operations Officer', 3: 'To all units. Command will be with you every step of the way. We will bring humanity its victory once again.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory211.png'}
{1: '1', 3: 'When the terminal screen glows to life, Lee is standing by the porthole.'}

{3: "Unlike the silent, endless void of space beyond Babylonia, the horizon out here smears into a hazy gray-blue, wrapped in something close to fog. It's much like humanity itself, lost in a long and stubborn twilight."}
{2: 'Mission Briefing', 3: 'Attention. Classified mission briefing. Recipient: Gray Raven.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Lucia turns her head sharply. Your eyes catch midair for a single beat, then both look down at yourselves at the same time.'}
{2: 'Acknowledged.', 3: '91'}

{2: 'Mission Briefing', 3: "Proceed to Berth 3, Port Podesta Shipyard. Board the Balder and set course along the Mid-Atlantic Ridge route toward the Atlantic Eye. Objective: intercept and block Arius Erhorn's advance."}
{2: 'Mission Briefing', 3: "Current intelligence indicates that the abilities of Arius' Understanding Sefirah may involve the deconstruction of physical matter."}
{2: 'Mission Briefing', 3: 'Should you face Arius directly during the operation, exercise extreme caution.'}
{2: 'Understood.', 3: '97'}
{2: 'Mission Briefing', 3: "Currently, global military communications remain disrupted, severely limiting Babylonia's military command and coordination."}

{2: 'Mission Briefing', 3: "Whether dealing with the Red Tide's continued spread across the ocean or responding to a potential attack by the Ascendants, we remain in an extremely disadvantageous position."}

{2: 'Mission Briefing', 3: "Therefore, en route to the Atlantic Eye, you are to link up with the Engineering Force's technical detachment in charge of undersea fiber-optic cable repairs, and provide assistance with both the repair work and escort duties where capacity allows."}
{2: 'Mission Briefing', 3: 'To accommodate naval combat and operational requirements, a Construct familiar to you has been assigned to join this operation.'}
{2: 'Mission Briefing', 3: 'Please proceed first to Transatlantic Hangar 7 to receive Construct frame BPD-72: Effulgence.'}
{2: 'Mission Briefing', 3: 'The frame has been fully calibrated for Red Tide and marine environments. Transport it with your squad and deliver it to its designated Construct when the time comes.'}
{2: 'Mission Briefing', 3: 'End of briefing. Please confirm mission details.'}
{2: 'Mission confirmed.', 3: '105'}
{2: 'Mission Briefing', 3: 'Gray Raven Commandant, good luck out there. We look forward to your success.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1382.jpg'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Transatlantic Hangar 7'}
{2: 'Transatlantic Hangar 7'}
{3: 'Lucia pushes against the door, and the metal hinges groan deep in their sockets.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lucia', 3: 'Still nothing on comms?', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Lee is fine-tuning the weapons. It is not necessary maintenance, but letting his hands move through something practiced and familiar while his mind works seems to bring his thoughts into sharper focus.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: "From the looks of it, the cables are still taking damage. At this rate, military comms won't hold out much longer.", 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Lucia', 3: "With the no-fly and no-sail zones, there aren't many ways to reach the dam at the Red Tide's source. Right now, only the Balder can get us directly to the epicenter.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Lee', 3: "Which means we'll be one of the first squads to reach the Atlantic Eye.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Lucia', 3: "And to keep the other Sefirah secure, Liv won't be joining us on this one.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Both of them look toward you as you raise your head from a stack of old files.'}
{3: 'No one dwells on it. This weight is one you have long since grown used to carrying.'}
{2: "How long until we're ready to move?", 3: '130'}
{3: 'Lee glances up. Hovering over the desk, the terminal projection pulses with streams of data stuttering and winking out in rapid cascades.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Lee', 3: "The new frame still needs a few more calibration tests. Once they've verified the last few parameters, we can head to the shipyard and link up with the others.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory597.jpg'}
{1: 'Port Podesta - Shipyard', 2: 'Meanwhile'}
{2: 'Meanwhile, Port Podesta - Shipyard.'}
{1: '1', 3: "Karenina stands on the highest gantry, her data pad's pale glow shimmering across her face like light reflected off water."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Accepting delivery of a new frame mid-mission, and the transfer coordinates are... huh?! It's actually out at sea.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Tch. Dammit.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Why the hell does a frame I designed myself have to take a joyride around the Transatlantic Economic Community? What kind of classified tech is so goddamn secret that even the captain of the Engineering Force can't get clearance?", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "New tech based on the Omega File and the Omega Weapons? And Balder's refit too... The second anything's tied to that, it gets slapped with top-secret clearance. Non-core personnel can't even get a peek...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "And even I have to submit a damn request and wait for approval... which still hasn't come through, by the way. And this is about my new frame, for crying out loud...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "They damn well better send someone reliable to deliver my frame, or I swear I'll flood the system with a hundred complaint tickets!", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1598.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1598.jpg'}
{3: "The ship sinks into the dock as the outer gates yawn wide. Salt water pours in, rising past the Balder's painted designation, and the vessel shifts, cradled by the flood."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory597.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.4'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory597.jpg'}
{3: "Karenina's face tightens with purpose. She turns to look down at the massive hull beneath her."}
{1: '1', 2: '??', 3: "Well? Doesn't it look just like a beast waking from hibernation?", 4: '1'}

{3: 'A voice sounds behind her. Karenina turns. An old woman is climbing the spiral stairs, a standard-issue Cosmos Technicians Union toolbox in her grip, her coat still carrying the damp chill of the sea.'}
{3: 'Her eyes are bright, fixed on Karenina with a smile that holds the fondness and pride of a grandmother.'}
{3: 'Karenina feels a prickle of unease under that gaze.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Wh-what are you staring at? Something on my face?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Who are you?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: "Mara shakes her head, still smiling. She mounts the last step of the spiral stair, shakes out the coat from her arm, and drapes it softly over Karenina's shoulders."}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "You've been up here a while, haven't you? Finished the report? Are you cold?", 4: '2'}
{3: "The woman leaves Karenina's question unanswered. The coat rests on her shoulders with a gentleness she cannot easily define. Affection from a maternal figure is a rarity in Karenina's life."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Cold? As if this temperature could even—', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She catches herself, senses she should be more courteous, and awkwardly reroutes her words mid-delivery.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "What I mean is... I'm a Construct. Temperature like this doesn't exactly bother me...", 4: '1'}
{3: "The old woman says nothing. She only lifts a hand and smooths the hair back from Karenina's forehead, the touch light and full of care."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: '(...The hell is happening right now?!!)', 4: '1'}
{3: "Karenina's Inver-Device shudders sharply. She stands paralyzed, caught off guard by this sudden wave of maternal affection from a mysterious elder."}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "Just because the cold can't hurt you doesn't mean you can't feel it. Right?", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Karenina opens her mouth, but nothing comes out.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: '(...What is she on about? Talking in riddles...)', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: 'Have you finished verifying the data of the fiber-optic nodes?', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Already went through all of it...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Karenina finds her voice back at last, only to furrow her brow a moment later, eyeing Mara with sharp suspicion.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'W-wait a second! Who even are you?!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: 'Cosmos Technicians Union. My name is Mara. Head of Troubleshooting at Fenrir, the southern node.', 4: '2'}
{3: "Karenina knows the name from the Cosmos Technicians Union's internal records, but she has never had any contact with this supposedly remarkable technician in her life."}
{3: 'She squares her shoulders, pretending it is the most casual movement in the world.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Captain of Babylonia's Engineering Force.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: "I know you. I've heard about you, Captain Karenina. I know who you are.", 4: '2'}

{2: 'Mara', 3: 'That data in your hands came from the first team of technicians we sent to troubleshoot the coastal cable station. They were my people. The original squad assigned to emergency repairs at the southern node Fenrir.', 4: '2'}
{3: "Karenina's fingers freeze on the data pad's edge. The realization hits."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "The data's thorough, and the report's well put together. I... heard that yesterday, they...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "Yes. They went dark. In a place the Corrupted could reach, but our comms couldn't.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "Communications... Doesn't seem like much until it's the thing that kills you. Funny how that works, isn't it?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "We've already scrambled replacements. Admittedly, some of them are way past their prime and a few are greener than grass. But the work doesn't care. Somebody's got to do it.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'She turns, gazing down from the gantry.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: 'I stayed behind to wait for the new crew. And to wait for you.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "Come with me, Captain Karenina. Let me show you how we're going to fix this broken world.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory598.jpg'}
{3: 'Mara guides Karenina around to the other side of the gantry. From this vantage point, the whole port opens up below them.'}
{3: 'A handful of ships rest at their moorings nearby, nothing like the massive Balder. They are leaner, quicker, their hulls still scarred with the rough marks of emergency modification.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Cable-laying ships. Retrofitted from escort vessels?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: "That's right. You've done your homework.", 4: '2'}
{3: "Karenina's brow creases a little."}
{3: "As captain of the Engineering Force, she cannot recall the last time anyone praised her work like a child's school assignment."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "(Dammit, she's treating me like some kind of rookie...)", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Her chin lifts with a retort on her lips, yet something in those gentle, timeworn eyes makes her look away.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I-it's not a big deal... My real skills are way beyond this stuff.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Mara laughs again, soft and fond, at the grumbling response Karenina mutters under her breath.'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: 'We need to finish calibrating these cable layers before the tide turns. After that... we head out and restore the entire Atlantic fiber-optic network.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'She pauses, as if assembling the right words. The wind lifts her hair and draws it across the lines of her face.'}

{2: 'Mara', 3: 'When the Punishing Virus first broke out, its corruption trait tore through the quantum fiber-optic network. That system was built on the most advanced AI humanity had, and the virus devoured it.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: 'But the atmospheric circulation patterns bought us more time over the oceans. The undersea fiber-optic network, especially the Atlantic systems, survived relatively intact.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'The virus spread way faster across land than it did through the ocean. I went through the reports before I got here.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: 'Exactly right. Well done.', 4: '2'}
{3: "Karenina feels a flicker of irritation pulse at her temple. Still, she makes the conscious choice to remain civil toward a woman who could easily be her grandfather's age."}
{2: 'Mara', 3: 'And so the military intelligence network, built on quantum-encrypted channels, found itself chained to this crumbling relic, left teetering in the wake of a dead era.', 4: '2'}

{2: 'Mara', 3: "The Science Council has been planning to overhaul the fiber-optic system for years. Boost the whole network's resistance to Punishing Virus corruption, sure. But also consolidate control over this critical lifeline and put an end to the shared governance.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Shared governance?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: 'A polite way of putting it. The Science Council has always wanted full control of the fiber-optic network. No more interference from the Transatlantic Economic Community.', 4: '2'}

{2: 'Mara', 3: "But the Council wasn't about to throw away the TEC's maritime technical support and joint training programs either. And the politicians in Parliament had their own calculations. Economic, political...", 4: '2'}
{3: "Mara stops speaking, her gaze settling on Karenina's face, which has crumpled into unmistakable annoyance."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Why can't any of this just be simple? Like an engineering problem!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'All this damn maneuvering... it really annoys me!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Mara eyes her puffed-out cheeks and gives a smiling nod.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: 'Yeah. It is annoying.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Mara', 3: '...To keep up with the plan, the Cosmos Technicians Union has been running emergency training for marine comms operations for a long time now. We even started rolling out parts of the work after the Copperfield Aquarium incident.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "But a crisis never waits until you're good and ready.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'A sigh escapes the old engineer.'}

{2: 'Mara', 3: "Beyond the standard fiber lines, the worst damage from the Red Tide hit the quantum repeaters along the deep-sea cables in the Atlantic. That's going to be the focus of our repair work.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She sketches a line in the empty air, a ghostly course drawn from one shore to the other.'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: 'The Jormungandr node, spanning the Mid-Atlantic Ridge. Fenrir to the south. And Hel, up north.', 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Those names... that's mythology, isn't it? I think I watched a movie about it with Bianca once. Doesn't sound like the Science Council's style at all. It's got the Kraken Bloc's taste written all over it.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: 'Kraken Bloc? Oh... you mean those families...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "So you're into movies? That's ador—", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I'm not into movies! And quit talking to me like I'm a kid!", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "That's a good hobby.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "The TEC has already sent its tech teams overland to the Hel node. The Cosmos Technicians Union will handle Fenrir down in the southern Atlantic. That one's my destination.", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory597.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory597.jpg'}
{3: 'She looks past the port, toward the open water and that faint, gray-blue seam drawn across the horizon.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory598.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.4'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory598.jpg'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: "Captain Karenina, your team's assignment... is the Jormungandr node along the Mid-Atlantic Ridge. The longest voyage and the most dangerous route, cutting straight through the restricted zone in the Red Tide.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'In the old stories of gods, it is the great serpent encircling the mortal realm.'}

{2: 'Mara', 3: "It's a loop circuit. Unlike the other two nodes, Jormungandr has no central control hub. That means every single repeater inside the restricted zone is critical. Every last one.", 4: '1'}
{3: "Karenina stares at the unseen route for a moment of silence, then shifts her gaze to the wrinkles worn into Mara's face."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "You're human, aren't you? No augments, no body mods... A mission like this could get you killed.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Mara offers no denial. Her expression holds its peace.'}

{2: 'Mara', 3: "Comms are barely hanging on right now. The investigation into the Atlantic Eye's Red Tide overflow has already siphoned off most of our Construct support. The personnel left for the subsea cable repairs... we're spread thin.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "When we're staffing this cable-laying operation, there's only one question that matters: can they get the job done? Everything else... doesn't matter.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Karenina knits her brow and presses her lips into a thin line.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: "I've got nothing left to teach the young ones. So let me be useful one last time... An adventure like this, at my age? Honestly, it's kind of exciting. Don't you think?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She turns her face toward Karenina, the look in her eyes tender and sure.'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "If this is the last chapter of my story, and the first line of it is getting to see you again... well. I'd call that a great ending.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: '...Huh? See me again?', 4: '2'}
{3: "Karenina freezes in place, her gaze locked on Mara's face as she digs deep into her memory."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "We've met? You know me?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: 'Yes. I know you, child.', 4: '1'}
{3: "She doesn't call her Captain Karenina this time."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "When? Why don't I remember you? Was it at the Cosmos Technicians Union?", 4: '1'}
{3: "Mara takes a moment. Her gaze travels back across the port, skimming the Balder's hull, until it rests on the open water, endless and gray-blue in the distance."}

{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: "The Balder's construction started way back in the Golden Age. Even settling on a name took forever. In the end, it inherited its designation from the first warship that went down in the Atlantic during the Punishing Virus outbreak.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Mara', 3: 'In the old stories, the death of Balder, the god of light, was what set Ragnarok in motion. And his return brought order to the new world... Karenina, you and your people are the hope of that new world.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The sea wind slips between them, thick with the smell of salt and rust.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Mara', 3: "The Atlantic... I thought I'd never come back here...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "Come on, child. We've got a lot of work to do.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Mara', 3: "The rest... I'll tell you when I get back. Alright?", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg'}

{3: "The emergency replacement crew arrives at last. Mara's cable layer readies for departure. Meanwhile, after all reinforcements bound for the Atlantic Eye are aboard, Karenina steps onto the Balder."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Have to pick up the new frame mid-voyage. Coordinates... What a pain. I already ran through every damn adaptation procedure.', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Readings crowd the console: speed, heading, thrust, hull pressure. Karenina accesses the drive system interface, and at the stern end of the vessel diagram, a green indicator blinks steadily. Status clear.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Not the worst.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She murmurs under her breath and looks out the window.', 4: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1582.jpg'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1582.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1582.jpg'}

{3: "A horn sounds across the port. Mara's cable layer, the Vega, is making ready to depart. All Karenina can see is its old, worn hull, but something about that unremarkable vessel holds her attention and refuses to let go."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.4'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: '...What is wrong with me today!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She shakes off the thought and works her way through the dials and buttons.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Knob resistance feels decent. Touchscreen response is solid, no lag. Physical buttons all check out... Hmph. Nothing surprising.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Control logic's clean too, integration's smooth... Where's this ugly code I was warned about? Works just fine if you ask me. Teddy... is so... damn... picky.", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg'}
{3: "Her gaze strays once more to the window, and this time she stands up. Mara's cable layer is moving out."}
{3: 'The sea churns around the hull, a white skirt of foam unfurling behind the stern as the vessel heads toward the South Atlantic.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Alright! Time we got moving too!', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1598.jpg'}
{3: "After decades of silence, a large vessel's departure protocol runs once more through this historic shipyard. The horn calls out across the water as the Balder clears the port wall."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg'}

{3: "Far off, the horizon is a thin, vanishing curve. The ship gains speed, the newly built cable layer Starshadow keeping pace at her flank, ready to serve as the work vessel once Karenina's team reaches the target waters."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk (Shortwave Comms)', 3: "Pressure differential nominal, flow rate nominal, Punishing Virus concentration within safe threshold. All clear, ma'am.", 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava (Shortwave Comms)', 3: "M-ma'am?! You bootlicking little...", 4: '18'}
{2: 'Sava (Shortwave Comms)', 3: "Pre-inspection parameters for the cable layer's deep-sea mode pending calibration. Bio-environmental monitoring underway. Captain Karenina... ma'am!", 4: '18'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Alright, alright...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Inside the central control room, the Construct girl raises her chin.'}

{3: "Ahead, the bow splits the gray-blue water, and the horizon widens without end. The wind greets them like a rough, familiar companion. The Balder and its cable layer keep pace with Mara's Vega for now, sharing the same heading before they scatter toward their separate fates."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "This is the Engineering Force's show now!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The sea spreads out before them, vast and placid.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk (Shortwave Comms)', 3: 'All clear on my end. You can head back to the Balder now.', 4: '18'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava (Shortwave Comms)', 3: "Got it. Open up the dock bay and I'll board from there. Hey, what's the captain doing?", 4: '18'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '18'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1617.jpg'}
{3: 'Three watertight doors and a series of sloping corridors lead from the bridge down to the dock bay. Karenina stands in one of those passageways now, running checks on the filtration systems.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Who knows if this so-called classified tech breakthrough is even legit...', 4: '1'}
{3: "The Balder's interior is deep gray, all smooth composite paneling without the rust-streaked pipes of older ships. Embedded lights gleam a steady, low green along the walls."}
{3: 'Through her Construct senses, Karenina feels the faint vibration running up from the deck, the rhythm of the stern thrusters pulsing steady as heartbeats.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'There... Finally done.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'By the time the methodical checks are done, time has slid by without notice. At the far end of the corridor, a dim glow has appeared.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Hm? Is the dock bay open?', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1617.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1617.jpg'}
{3: 'Chatter drifts in from the dock bay. The Construct girl straightens her hair, rumpled from the long work session, and moves toward the noise.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1600.jpg'}
{3: "The dock bay gapes open to the ocean. Its enormous gate is lifted, and light, wind, and the sea's gray-blue hue spill inside, thick with the smell of salt and open water."}
{1: '1', 3: 'A man stands before the vastness, his back to the room. His engineering coat, once TEC standard issue, has been scoured pale by years of sea and sun.'}
{3: 'He appears middle-aged, but his body carries a deeper wear, an older sickness. Only his eyes are undimmed, shining cold and clear like thin ice over shallows.'}
{2: '??', 3: '"You summoned me, Odin, to recount the first deeds of gods and men. Flames of dying stars burned the boughs of Yggdrasil."', 4: '1'}
{3: 'His recitation is slow and ancient, each word coarse and grave, like sea-rock shaped by millennia of surf.'}
{3: 'Anyone trained in poetry or linguistics would recognize it as Old Norse, a language no longer spoken anywhere.'}
{1: '1', 2: '??', 3: '"At the doors of Hel, Fenrir let forth his howl. Thus began all things, with the monstrous wolf who slipped his fetters and ran free."', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Two technicians from the Engineering Force are busy with something in the corner. At the sound of the recitation, they move closer without thinking.'}
{2: 'Sava', 3: "Uh... What's he doing?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'No idea... Some kind of Transatlantic ritual?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sava', 3: 'Wait, is he the marine engineer TEC sent? That Larsen guy?', 4: '2'}
{3: 'Two rookies on their first deployment are clearly still unaware of the unspoken social rule that whispering about someone requires actually whispering.'}
{3: 'Larsen pivots toward them, resigned.'}
{3: 'The technicians stiffen and fire off a salute before even thinking.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "...Hello. I'm Larsen, an engineer from the Transatlantic Economic Community. That wasn't some kind of ritual back there. Just... an old poem from my homeland.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "It's about a prophecy of the sea, voyages, and how the survivors of Ragnarok would build a new world.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: 'I... have a soft spot for poetry.', 4: '1'}
{3: "Sava's head pumps up and down as if his life depends on it."}
{2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'Ragnarok... yeah, totally not a religious thing...', 4: '2'}
{3: 'The one with the impossibly long name leans in to whisper to his companion, only to receive a swift, merciless elbow to the ribs in return.'}
{2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'Ow!', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: 'So, what are you doing?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'Fishing... Ow...', 4: '2'}
{3: 'A second elbow jab lands. Sidkosanatrahk turns to Sava, bewildered.'}
{3: "The look on his companions' faces, however, says everything: you're done for. He follows their frozen stares and finds Captain Karenina, already in the dock bay, watching."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'So, what are you doing?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Their captain, not to be trifled with, pins them under a glare that spells pure trouble.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: "W-we're running bio-environmental checks, Captain Karenina!", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.7', 5: '0.3'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: "There's this artificial creature created by the TEC, called Huhu. They're really sensitive to environmental shifts. More sensitive than our monitoring gear, actually. Their survival numbers in a given area make for a solid early bioindicator.", 4: '18', 5: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0.7', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{3: "Karenina's gaze sweeps over the gear at their side. The complete set of monitoring tools and bio-trawling equipment proves their story checks out."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "Yeah, boss. We're fishing for Huhu.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'How many so far?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The two technicians trade a look. The older one reaches up and scratches the back of his head.'}
{2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'Well, if we get this one...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "...and then two more, that'll be three.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'A few seconds of silence pass. Larsen cranes his neck and takes in the holding tank, which contains absolutely nothing.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "So you haven't caught a single one.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "Heheh... look, it hasn't been that long, okay? We're just trying to loosen up a little before we hit the mission zone. Everyone's been on edge...", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "Besides, catching fish is like the least important part of fishing! It's about the experience!", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "Who fishes while the ship's still underway...? First time out? You wait till you're anchored.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Making fools of yourselves in front of the Transatlantic guy, and now you're trying to bull**** me? You're dead.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: "C-Captain, we really haven't spotted a single Huhu in these waters, which is actually kind of weird now that I think about it... Captain, that's my arm you're grabbing, that's MY arm, ow ow ow...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'While Karenina exercises discipline over her crew, a sound rises from the deep, pitched well below the range of human ears.'}
{3: 'The frequency slips under every bioacoustic filter the engineers have set. The instruments detect nothing.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "Captain Karenina, something's not right.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The TEC marine engineer moves to the edge of the open bay door. Below, the fish are clustering together in a tight, wrong-looking mass.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Alphabet, give me the latest marine life readings. Now.', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory616.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory616.jpg'}
{3: 'The school condenses into a writhing carpet of silver, fish leaping and crashing back in endless turmoil. The noise of it fills the air like a rain squall hitting open water.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "What the hell... It's not even raining out.", 4: '18'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1291.jpg'}
{3: 'A flying fish bursts from the water, arcs over the bay door, and hits the deck with a wet slap.'}
{3: "It lands not twenty centimeters from Karenina's feet, its pectoral fins spread wide like two sheer wings, gills pumping in frantic, shallow flutters."}
{3: 'The foreboding swells, cold and certain, and Karenina whips her head toward the horizon.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory616.jpg'}
{3: 'A whale cries out across the water.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1446.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3CommenScreenDate.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'A vast shape heaves upward where the sky meets the sea, and something deep in her memory brushes softly against the present.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiTheatre3/FxUiTheatre3CommenScreenDate.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1291.jpg'}
{3: 'Gravity strips the water from its colossal frame. The clear droplets shimmer in the sun for a single bright moment, then shift to a deep, ominous crimson.'}
{3: 'The creature hangs in the air only a heartbeat longer, then tilts and slams back into the ocean. The white wall of spray stains red almost before it can rise.'}
{3: 'Wet, torn flesh and corroded copper bonework knit together into a shape out of nightmare, and its body is threaded through with swollen, twisting veins like parasitic roots.'}
{3: 'Calling it a humpback whale feels wrong.'}
{3: 'Its irises and pupils are gone, swallowed by an abyssal blackness, leaving behind two hollow sockets that burn with a dim, pulsing red.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "...No. That thing's been reshaped by the Red Tide!", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory616.jpg'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{3: "The whale call pierces the air once more, a twisted echo of the humpback's deep and graceful song, but there is no beauty in it, only undiluted pain."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory616.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory616.jpg'}
{3: 'Farther out, more shapes break the horizon, rising together from every direction. Their red backs form a ragged curve against the water, strung like a necklace of dark, bloodied pearls.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1291.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "A whole pod... There's more than one of these monsters...", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiSHanshuoNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'His voice is drowned out by the shriek of the Punishing Virus alarm. The bay ceiling erupts in flashing red, the warning lights whirling and pulsing with frantic, manic energy.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: 'Captain! Requesting permission to engage!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'He rises fast, his features setting into hard lines.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiSHanshuoNew.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: "Captain Karenina... Captain?! What's wrong?!", 4: '2'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.5', 5: '0'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}
{3: "Karenina's palm is clamped tight to her brow."}
{3: 'Something has bypassed every defense, exploding in an unguarded corner deep inside her M.I.N.D., or maybe it has always been there.'}
{3: 'The whale calls crash through her consciousness, each reverberation a new spike of pain.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Dammit... if this keeps up, my M.I.N.D... the deviation... I'm gonna...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The frequency scrapes through her M.I.N.D. like a needle dragged raw across glass, every vibration sickening and wrong.'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: "...Combat personnel, begin battle preparations. I'll handle things here. Is there a frame maintenance researcher on board? Get them here now.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "The whales... that sound... something's wrong with it, it's not... agh...", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: 'Whales? You mean... the sound of the whales...?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Sava', 3: "Those whales... haven't made a single sound...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The new Engineering Force recruit seems seconds away from crying.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: '...Could be a signal reception error.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Larsen', 3: "I'll take care of this... You two focus on what you can do.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The accompanying frame technician sprints over and hands a maintenance log to Larsen.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Larsen', 3: '...No acoustic spectrum readings at all? But...', 4: '1'}

{3: 'One by one, the whales exhale, their spouts climbing and collapsing in staggered rhythm. Overhead, the red mist gathers and stitches itself together, unfurling into an immense curtain of blood that spreads slowly across the water.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.7', 5: '0.8'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Her vision blurs at the edges. Everyone surges toward her, hands gripping her arms to hold her up. She shoves the nearest hand away and immediately lurches sideways.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0.7', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Issue... ship-wide alert... all hands to battle stations...', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiActivityBranch/FxUiActivityBranchSmokeRed.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHuaping.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'The edges of the bay come apart in her sight, the bulkheads bleeding pigment like paper left in water.'}
{3: "The alarm's red glow no longer pulses; it has thickened into a steady, suffocating mist."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory843.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '0.4', 5: '0.8'}
{3: 'The horizon turns blood-red, eating away at her vision inch by inch.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiActivityBranch/FxUiActivityBranchSmokeRed.prefab'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHuaping.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sidkosanatrahk', 3: "Battle prep's done, Larsen! How's the captain...?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Sava', 3: "Captain, the Vega just sent a distress call over shortwave. They're trapped in the middle of the pod.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1582.jpg'}

{1: '1', 3: 'At that same moment, Mara stands on the deck of the Vega. This ship was built to face two enemies and two only: brutal weather and hidden reefs. Now abominations born of the Punishing Virus are tightening the noose.'}

{3: 'She releases a slow breath. This kind of loss was always a possibility. Even if she falls here, other teams on other routes will push on toward the southern node. Her real concern sits not far away.'}
{3: 'The Balder. That is what the whale pod is truly after.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg'}
{3: "On the Balder's tactical display, a new signal source connects to the shortwave communications network."}
